 JNVST Class 6 admit card 2027 out at navodaya.gov.in; direct download link here
 NVS has released JNVST Class 6 admit cards for the 2027-28 session. Students can download them online using their registration number and date of birth before November 28.
 Curated by Yash Wardhan Singh 
 Image: Official website 
 Oct 28, 2026
 Share
 The Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) has made the admit cards available for the Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test (JNVST) 2027-28 for Class 6 entry. Students taking the entrance test can get their hall tickets from the official website, navodaya.gov.in, by entering their registration number and date of birth. 
 The first phase of the entrance exam for summer-bound Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas will be conducted on November 28, 2026. Students must bring a printed copy of their admit card to the exam centre. They will need the required documents to enter the examination hall. 
 The hall ticket provides key information, such as the student's details, exam centre, reporting time and instructions for the examination. Students and parents should review all the information carefully after downloading it. 
 How to Download the JNVST Class 6 Admit Card 2027 
 Students and parents can use these steps to get the hall ticket: 
 1. Go to the official NVS website at navodaya.gov.in. 
 2. Find the section for JNVST Class 6 admission or admit cards. 
 3. Select the link for the Class 6 admit card 2027. 
 4. Enter the student's registration number and date of birth. 
 5. Submit the information to open the hall ticket. 
 6. Download the admit card and print a copy for exam day. 
 Keep the printed hall ticket safely and remember to take it to the examination centre on November 28. 
 Details to Verify on the Admit Card 
 After downloading the hall ticket, students should make sure the following information is correct: 
 Student's name 
 Registration information 
 Address of the examination centre 
 Reporting time 
 Exam-day instructions 
 If students or parents notice any incorrect information, they should contact the concerned authorities through the official NVS channels for help.
